mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sekai_form_character WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM sekai_form_character WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sekai_form_character(user_id, name, description, model_type, model_path, satiety, mood, affection, level, exp, free_points, hp, atk, def, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{modelType}, #{modelPath}, #{satiety}, #{mood}, #{affection}, #{level}, #{exp}, #{freePoints}, #{hp}, #{atk}, #{def}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sekai_form_character SET name=#{name}, description=#{description}, model_type=#{modelType}, model_path=#{modelPath}, satiety=#{satiety}, mood=#{mood}, affection=#{affection}, level=#{level}, exp=#{exp}, free_points=#{freePoints}, hp=#{hp}, atk=#{atk}, def=#{def}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
